name: ShipStation
description: Multi-carrier shipping and fulfillment via your own ShipStation account (API V2) -- compare rates across carriers, create and manage shipments, purchase/void/download labels (including multi-package and return labels), batch-process labels, generate customs manifests, schedule carrier pickups, manage warehouses, custom package types, products, tags, and webhooks. Bring-your-own-account (BYOK): connect your own ShipStation V2 API key, every call runs against your own account, your own carriers, and your own postage balance.
